name: Samgyetang
description: A whole young chicken stuffed with rice, ginseng and jujube, simmered to collapse.

tcm.note: Ginseng and chicken together — a classically warming, qi-tonifying soup eaten in midsummer to build strength.

nutrition.highlight: eaten in midsummer, to build strength

effects.note: A systematic review of eight RCTs on ginseng found a real anti-fatigue effect with sustained use, distinct from a caffeine-style jolt — genuinely one of the better clinical crossovers of a traditional tonic. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
